title: The Victoria completes the first circumnavigation
summary: The ship Victoria, commanded by Juan Sebastian Elcano, reached Sanlucar de Barrameda with 18 survivors, three years after Magellan's fleet of five ships had set out.
reason: The expedition had sought a western route to the Spice Islands, and the survivors returned westward around Africa.
significance: It was the first voyage around the world and proved the true size of the Earth's oceans.
